newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gasoline prices to rise 14 pct today - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gasoline prices to rise 14 pct today - paper.

text.p: Brazilian gasoline prices were expected to rise on Tuesday by 14 percent at the pump, up from government estimates of between eight and 10 percent, a local newspaper said.
Gazeta Mercantil said fuel distributors calculated the higher increase after studying price tables provided on Monday by state oil monopoly Petrobras, which first week announced the fuel hike.
The paper, quoting Odilon Lacerda of the Fuel Retailers of Rio, said distributors found that gasoline would rise 14 percent while hydrous alcohol, which is used as a fuel, would rise 19 percent.
The report could not be immediately verified. The government last week estimated the rise would be between eight and 10 percent.
Lacerda said the rise would be entirely passed on to consumers.
Gazeta said Petrobras President Joel Renno declined to comment on the rise.
"That's the government's responsibility, not the company's," he was quoted as saying. "From the refinery to the pump, what rules is the law of the market."
